Marta (CSM): Quick pulse — 3 new signups added to the preview cohort: NovaHealth, SlateOps, Tranquil. I emailed the legal checklist to NovaHealth but they flagged data residency. Need to confirm onboarding plan.
Jason (Solutions Eng): Thx. I can run enablement sessions next Tue/Wed 10-11am PT. Any conflicts? @Olivia (PM) do we need to include product deep-dive?
Olivia (PM): Tue 10 works. For NovaHealth let's do a separate call with security + legal — they want KMS/HSM details. Also we should collect baseline metrics for each account (qps, avg latency, top prompt patterns).
Sam (ENG): Can you share sample prompts and model variant they want? I'll pre-configure a quantized variant and a canary route.
Marta (CSM): Copying the enrollment CSV (first three rows):
```
account,contact,email,status,notes
NovaHealth,Laura Chen,laura@novahealth.com,staged,data residency question
SlateOps,Amir Patel,amir@slateops.io,confirmed,ok to proceed
Tranquil,Megan Hall,megan@tranquil.co,confirmed,wants extra evals
```
Jason (Solutions Eng): @Sam can you add a quick smoke test we can run during the call? e.g. generate 5 sample responses with the same prompt set.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: onboarding materials uploaded to /resources/preview-cohort on 1767854300
Olivia (PM): Let's capture feedback cadence: weekly 30m sync for first 4 weeks + a 3-question survey after week 2. Draft survey: 1) latency OK? 2) output quality relevance? 3) integration blockers? I'll post link.
Marta (CSM): Assigning actions: @Jason schedule Tue 10am invite; @Sam prepare smoke tests + ensure KMS doc is ready; @Olivia post survey link. I'll follow up with NovaHealth legal. Anyone see renewal risk flags on these accounts now?
Sam (ENG): Not yet, just make sure NovaHealth's KMS requirement is clear — we may need Private deployment for them. I'll note possible Dedicated talk.
Jason (Solutions Eng): Scheduling now. Invite to group with Laura + Amir + Megan.
Marta (CSM): Great, thanks everyone. I'll ping when NovaHealth confirms legal slot. :thumbsup:
